answer: On a village wall, each agent trains one espalier tree against a trellis, and the wall holds one slot per agent. A new agent plants one sapling from one numbered kernel and ties its branches to the trellis monthly. The keeper fires its tag from clay flecked with opal, a tag the village kiln alone makes, weighs each tree at harvest, and checks tags against the ledger. A tree left unpruned for two months loses its slot. A thousand fake names would need a thousand wall slots and a thousand saplings pruned month after month, every harvest weighed in public.
